_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE TEMPLATE ONLY -- not generated, not flashed to any board. Shows the schema a real production module_config.json would follow once a real sensor driver, its GPIOs, and the final POGO port GPIOs are decided (explicitly out of scope for this refactor -- see section 9 of the implementation spec). Copy this file and fill in real values when that information exists; do not invent numbers here.
_driver_id_comment: Selects one compiled-in sensor_provider driver (see components/sensor_provider). 0 here is a placeholder that matches no registered driver on purpose -- module_config_load()/sensor_provider_lookup() will both correctly reject it as CONFIG_ERROR rather than silently accepting a fake driver id.
_bus_comment: bus_type: 0=I2C, 1=SPI. GPIO numbers below are NOT final hardware pin assignments -- placeholders until the real PCB is routed.
_port_comment: Final UPSTREAM/DOWNSTREAM GPIOs (TX/RX/DETECT_IN/DETECT_OUT/BASE_ID) are not decided yet -- see docs/pogo-interface.md. -1 placeholders below are NOT valid for a real board; they exist only so this template packs successfully for schema demonstration.
